plan.title: release: Step 3 lifecycle sync hard-fails when GitHub REST core rate limit is exhausted

narratives.Description: Add capped sleep+retry on HTTP 403 rate-limit during release Step 3 issue-state fetch, actionable FAIL text with rate_limit probe, and document --allow-vbrief-drift escape after local vbrief:validate is green.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

`task release` Step 3 (`Pre-flight vBRIEF lifecycle sync`) hard-failed during the v0.78.0 cut when gh REST returned HTTP 403 API rate limit exceeded while `core.remaining: 0`.

## Expected

- One capped sleep+retry on HTTP 403 rate-limit during issue-state fetch
- Actionable FAIL text with remaining/reset + `gh api rate_limit` probe
- `--allow-vbrief-drift` documented as escape after local `vbrief:validate` is green
narratives.Labels: bug, blocks-release-tag, operational, scm, github, area:release, release
narratives.UserStory: As a release operator, I want Step 3 lifecycle sync to retry once on REST core rate-limit exhaustion and emit actionable recovery guidance, so that a transient bucket stall does not force a multi-hour cut with no in-pipeline backoff.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add release/issue-state-fetch.ts with capped rate-limit retry and actionable failure formatting.
2. Wire checkVbriefLifecycleSyncNative to use the release fetch wrapper.
3. Document --allow-vbrief-drift rate-limit escape in content/commands.md.
4. Add unit tests and CHANGELOG entry.
narratives.Acceptance:
1. Capped retry on HTTP 403 rate-limit during Step 3 issue-state fetch
2. Actionable FAIL text with rate_limit probe guidance
3. Drift escape documented in commands.md
4. Tests and CHANGELOG

narrative.Acceptance: Given REST core rate-limit exhaustion (HTTP 403), when Step 3 fetches issue states, then it sleeps once (capped) and retries before failing.
Given retry still fails, when Step 3 emits FAIL, then stderr includes core remaining/reset from gh api rate_limit and recovery guidance including --allow-vbrief-drift after vbrief:validate green.
Given commands.md and unit tests, when operators read release docs or CI runs, then drift escape and retry behavior are covered.
